business_problem: SkyHive helps job seekers and organizations overcome this challenge by providing market intelligence for normalizing global job listings across industries. Its traditional Hadoop infrastructure, however, struggled with the tremendous amounts of data being processed and analyzed — creating scalability and speed issues, limiting efficacy, and impacting the end-user experience.
solution_summary: SkyHive helps job seekers and organizations overcome this challenge by providing market intelligence for normalizing global job listings across industries. Its traditional Hadoop infrastructure, however, struggled with the tremendous amounts of data being processed and analyzed — creating scalability and speed issues, limiting efficacy, and impacting the end-user experience. Choosing to move beyond the data warehouse, SkyHive selected Databricks Data + AI Platform over a cloud data warehouse because it provides multicloud support and the ability to unify all its data for analytics and AI, from a single platform. With the lakehouse as the infrastructure behind its data intelligence, SkyHive can now democratize labor opportunities, helping organizations build and scale a capable workforce more efficiently.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Sharing
solution_components.role: Delivers governed data access across agencies, partners, or business units without copying datasets.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow
solution_components.role: Coordinates ingestion and transformation workflows across the lakehouse.

data_flow: Customer, product, and engagement data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables, with pipelines coordinated through Databricks orchestration and transformation services, and is served to downstream users and applications through Delta Sharing.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 13x Faster delivery of new applications to market.
metrics: 13x Faster delivery of new applications to market
architecture_clues: Uses Delta Sharing for governed data access across teams or partners.
